in_hebrew.name: בִיקָלֶס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'bakal' meaning 'to fight' or 'strong'. The name Bikales thus means 'Strong in battle'.

in_greek.name: Βικάλες
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'bikos' meaning 'victory' or 'triumph'. The name Bikales thus means 'Victorious'.

in_latin.name: Bikales
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'biculus' meaning 'strong' or 'powerful'. The name Bikales thus means 'Strong'.
